# Niche

> Niche is a comprehensive educational platform providing data-driven insights and tools for college admissions, K-12 school selection, and educational planning.

Niche offers college rankings, school profiles, direct admissions services, cost calculators, and marketing solutions for educational institutions. The platform combines AI-powered matching with standardized test prep resources and institutional analytics to help students and families make informed educational decisions.

## Key Topics

- College Admissions
- K-12 Schools
- Direct Admissions
- College Costs
- SAT/ACT
- Educational Planning
- Niche Pixel
- Attribution Modeling
- Boarding Schools
- Niche Profile
- Conversion Tracking
- GPA
- Digital Marketing
- ROI Measurement
- Student Motivation

## Educational Content & Insights

- [Niche Blog](https://articles.niche.com/): Blog articles on K-12 schools, colleges, places to live, and educational planning

## Marketing & Analytics Tools

- [The Niche Pixel](https://a.niche.com/the-niche-pixel/): Niche Pixel product for conversion and attribution tracking, enabling educators to measure ROI and understand student journey through view-through and conversion tracking
